_comment: Who stands on the maps and talks (the old game's game_world._setup_npcs). `name` is what quests name as giver and talk target; `dialogue` pages are English source strings (the client translates them); `robe` tints the robe and the dialogue medallion; `body` is a custom model (else the robed wizard); `services` opens a window from the dialogue (`workshop` = the wandmaker's refine and imbue). The server range-checks a talk against `pos` (quests.json talk_radius).

teral_venn.name: Commander Teral Venn
dialogue: So you are the new recruit. Beneath the lake lies Kaf's shard of the World-Star Ithrel; the Vigil has stood watch over it since the castle's first stone.
Black Weavers infest the Raven Woods to the west. Saltwights haunt its edge, past Ombrek's lookout.

Someone - the old records say the Ash Priest - drags darkened shards out of the Void. They fall in the western forests, from the Forest Edge past Ombrek's lookout to Bandit Woods in the north-west. Close by, you will see their green light.
From level 5 the Trial Hall is open: it stands on the east terrace, south of the castle road. Press F at its glowing door.

kestrin.name: Kestrin
dialogue: A rod is only as good as its maker... and the Oril behind it!
My forge is here on Orvell square, but press O anywhere to open my workshop. Bring Forge Cinder, Deepvein Ore, Starfall Filings.
+4 glows blue, +7 crackles gold, +9 burns with starfire!

bessa_tull.name: Bessa Tull
bessa_tull.role: Caravan Factor of the Red Lantern
bessa_tull._pos: In front of the Red Lantern's door, clear of its eaves and awning: at 684, -174 the first surface from the sky was the inn's roof edge (47 m, 9 m up), so she stood on the roof (2026-11-16).
dialogue: You made it off the road in one piece. Rest here - the village square is safe.
Buy Healing Draughts before heading to the Raven Woods. Trust me.

borin.name: Ombrek
dialogue: Nobody walks the Raven Woods alone on my watch. Take a torch and a second pair of eyes.
Saltwights are dry as tinder - Flame Wave goes through them like a grass fire. Starnail pins them in place.

emrel_sav.name: Archivist Emrel Sav
dialogue: The rolls are inside, past the great doors. Mind the dust; it is older than you.
The Long Table is through the entrance hall. The drill rooms are across from it.

kaelen_rook.name: Sergeant Kaelen Rook
dialogue: Listen close: Starnail interrupts, Flame Wave burns, and Hushing Gale weakens attacks.
Practise in the training yard beside the landing pad, then pull a pack together. Watch the boss's warning circle.
